title: crepidomanes rupicola
intro: Crepidomanes rupicola, commonly known as the rock climbing fern, is a species of epiphytic fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Crepidomanes rupicola include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities, and protect against cellular damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
